claims.claim_text: When the off-center distance exceeds one meter, a virtual human intervention is triggered, and the virtual vehicle position and orientation is reset to match the ground truth of the corresponding frame of the original test video.
claims.normalized_text: Virtual human intervention is triggered when off-center distance exceeds one meter, resetting vehicle position and orientation to ground truth.

claims.claim_text: Evaluating our networks is done in two steps, first in simulation, and then in on-road tests.
claims.normalized_text: Network evaluation is performed first in simulation, then in on-road tests.

claims.claim_text: In simulation we have the networks provide steering commands in our simulator to an ensemble of prerecorded test routes that correspond to about a total of three hours and 100 miles of driving in Monmouth County, NJ.
claims.normalized_text: Networks provide steering commands in simulation on prerecorded test routes totaling about three hours and 100 miles in Monmouth County, NJ.

claims.claim_text: The test data was taken in diverse lighting and weather conditions and includes highways, local roads, and residential streets.
claims.normalized_text: Test data includes diverse lighting and weather conditions and various road types: highways, local roads, and residential streets.

claims.claim_text: We estimate what percentage of the time the network could drive the car (autonomy).
claims.normalized_text: Autonomy is estimated as the percentage of time the network can drive the car without intervention.

claims.claim_text: The metric is determined by counting simulated human interventions (see Section 6).
claims.normalized_text: Autonomy metric is determined by counting simulated human interventions.

claims.claim_text: These interventions occur when the simulated vehicle departs from the center line by more than one meter.
claims.normalized_text: Simulated human interventions occur when the vehicle departs from the center line by more than one meter.
